dct_description_sm: Nunavummiut are seeing impacts on infrastructure from permafrost changes, which are affecting building foundations, drainage, and causing slumping of entire hillsides. Nunavut community homeowners do not have access to the necessary resources on permafrost; they do not have the critical information that will enable them to adapt to these changes and protect their homes from the potential damages that could be caused by climate change. This project seeked to address these issues and provide the information necessary for individuals within Nunavut communities to adapt to changes in permafrost.
